item.title: Continuous Batching — Who Gets the Next GPU Iteration?
item.description:
Continuous Batching — Who Gets the Next GPU Iteration?

The speculative decoding note left one request making progress on a GPU while other requests waited outside. Suppose your GPU has room to serve two requests together. One finishes its answer in the next iteration. The other needs three more. When can you use the freed capacity to start a third conversation?
